findings.title: Possible NPE when the 'Clients' resource-type resource is missing
findings.body: In hasPermission(ClientModel, String) when no per-client resource exists, the code falls back to AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceTypeResource(...), which can return null (it returns null when the realm does not support the authorization schema, when the resource type is unknown, or when the resource was never created/was deleted). The returned value is immediately passed to policyStore.findByResource(server, resource) and later to new ResourcePermission(resource, resource.getScopes(), server), causing a NullPointerException (HTTP 500) instead of a clean 403. A null check returning false is needed.

findings.title: Listener throws UnsupportedOperationException when both FGAP v1 and v2 are enabled
findings.body: registerListener now only runs when ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ (v1) is enabled, but management() returns MgmtPermissionsV2 whenever ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 is enabled. If both features are enabled simultaneously, removing a client triggers clients().setPermissionsEnabled(...) on ClientPermissionsV2, which throws UnsupportedOperationException("Not supported in V2"), breaking client/role/group deletion. The guard should also exclude the case where v2 is active (or the v1 implementation should be used explicitly here).

findings.title: getResourceName not implemented for the new Clients resource type
findings.body: getResourceName handles only USERS: for a policy with resourceType 'Clients' it falls through to resource.getDisplayName(), which is not set for resources created by getOrCreateResource (resources are created with name=client UUID and no display name). As a result admin/UI consumers get null instead of the client's clientId, or 'Clients' instead of a readable 'All clients' label. Add a Clients branch resolving the client by id.

findings.title: Dead code: unused getEvaluationContext and unused imports/constants
findings.body: getEvaluationContext(ClientModel, AccessToken) is private and never referenced (canExchangeTo throws UnsupportedOperationException), as are the logger field, the static TOKEN_EXCHANGE import and the Scope/ClientModelIdentity/DefaultEvaluationContext imports. Dead code copied from V1 misleads readers into thinking token-exchange evaluation is wired up; it should be removed.
